summary: NGS survey mark named Roscommon Lookout Tower in Crawford County; first observed 1932, recorded in good condition in 1949. No source describes the site today.

events.note: First survey observation of the station. The datasheet gives no construction date for the tower.
Coast and Geodetic Survey recovered the mark in good condition and observed it at the center of the top of the lookout tower.

corrections.why: The NGS Data Sheet is the source document, not a managing agency. The datasheet and the forest lookouts site name no agency that runs the tower.

sources.title: NGS Data Sheet, PID PL0431 (Roscommon Lookout Tower)

notes_for_editor: Only the NGS datasheet and one listing page were found, and neither gives the tower's build date, owner, staffing, or fate. Brief elevation (408 m) is not supported by any source found; the datasheet has no elevation line. Brief coordinates are about 60 m from the NGS position, so they probably mark the same site. NHLR does not list this tower and the Michigan former-sites register lists only Bliss and Paulding. Two WebSearch calls and one anyplaceamerica fetch (403) turned up nothing more.
